fact: The Annuaire statistique 2023-2024 of the technical education and vocational training ministry (METFPE), with a preface dated 28 May 2025, publishes statistics from data collected directly from training establishments between 13 and 22 December 2024 by questionnaire, drawn from the establishment and learner records sources EETFP and SNIEM.
title: Annuaire statistique 2023-2024
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement Technique, de la Formation Professionnelle et de l'Emploi (METFPE), Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement
